## Task runtime 0.26 — schema literal migration (2026-10-01)

**Trigger:** `plan-work.py prepare … P0.2` under Task 0.26.2 refused before any product write:
`Routing: no executable table with exact header … | Why`, then `Meta: no field 'Version' in owner view`.
`plan-lint` reported 14 errors on a plan that was lint-clean on 2026-09-29.

**Cause:** swissknifeman `c7af3894` (Task 0.26.0, «перевод репозитория на английский») translated the schema
literals the parser matches (`Поле|Значение` → `Field|Meaning`, `## Решение/## Почему` → `## Solution/## Why`,
`> СКЕЛЕТ — не детализирован` → `> SKELETON — not detailed`, `**Вердикт:` → `**Verdict:`, Routing `Почему` → `Why`,
Exported/Consumed column names, Title prefix `План №` → `Plan №`) with no legacy reader. Runtime regression, owned by
swissknifeman, outside this plan.

**Local repair (plan-owned, deterministic, reversible by `git revert`):** only those literals were renamed —
`@plan/plan.json` (Meta header, Title prefix, Routing `Why`, Exported/Consumed headers), `decisions/D01–D08`
(`## Solution`, `## Why`, `## Consequences`), `backlog/P1–P8` skeleton marker, `@plan/knowledge/findings-design-audit.json` verdict line.
Generated views (`@plan/plan.json`, decisions views, `*.state.md`, bundles) regenerated by `plan-views.py`. No semantic
content, scope, acceptance or decision text changed. After repair: `plan-lint: OK (0 errors, 0 warnings)`.

Not migrated (prose, not parsed as schema): Russian body text, `@plan/plan.json` table (rewritten by `finalize`).
`@plan/plan.json` declares no `**Design Audit:**`, so no design-audit fingerprint gates execution.
